title: 2.3 Natural and Human Induced Climate Change
description: Milankovitch cycles, solar output, volcanic aerosols, land use change and greenhouse gas emissions. Easy level.

questions.question: What are the three external causes of climate change?
options: A change in the mean or variability of climate persisting for decades or longer
Systems that accumulate and store greenhouse gases, such as forests and oceans
They interact at boundaries to form features such as mountains and earthquakes
Changes in incoming solar radiation, atmospheric composition and Earth surface
questions.correctAnswer: Changes in incoming solar radiation, atmospheric composition and Earth surface

questions.question: What are internal causes of climate change?
options: It reduces emissions through modern efficient technologies
Ocean and atmosphere circulation that redistributes energy
Tropical regions where many developing nations are located
Shock waves released by shifting rock during an earthquake
questions.correctAnswer: Ocean and atmosphere circulation that redistributes energy
